feeds.title: Graceful Atheist » Agnosticism
feeds.description: Read about Agnosticism by the Graceful Atheist. My name is David and I am trying to be the Graceful Atheist. After twenty some odd years of being a Christian my faith broke down in 2015. I could no longer sustain belief. It seemed to me the deeper I dug for truth in my beliefs the shakier they became. In contrast, the deeper I dug for truth in science and reason the more profound it became.
